decided: Each sensor reading, whether it fired or not, is recorded by orbit in the record each step of the flow already writes when it finishes. Orbit writes a stop of the tripwire kind only when that sensor is set to halt, and that stop is what makes a chained run wait.
alternatives: write a tripwire stop on every firing, even when nothing is set to halt
keep readings in a separate check the workflow has to remember to call
why: A stop written on every firing would be read by the default reviewer and would halt any chained run regardless of the sensor's own setting; recording quiet runs too shows that the sensors actually ran.

relies_on.title: The change status says whether the next command may run unasked

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
What one run of a sensor reports: whether it fired, and what it saw.
